findings.claim: In account-ui, error-invalid-multivalued-size was changed from i18next {{N}} placeholders to MessageFormat {N}/choice syntax. account-ui uses default i18next interpolation without i18next-icu, so the string renders with raw placeholders.

verifier.reason: The patch changes `error-invalid-multivalued-size` in js/apps/account-ui/maven-resources/theme/keycloak.v3/account/messages/messages_en.properties:188 from `{{0}}`/`{{1}}`/`{{2}}` to MessageFormat `{0}`/`{1}`/`{2}` and `{2,choice,...}` syntax. However, account-ui configures i18next with default `{{}}` interpolation and no `i18next-icu` plugin (js/apps/account-ui/src/i18n.ts:25-46, js/apps/account-ui/package.json:24-39), and translates server validation errors client-side via `setUserProfileServerError` (js/libs/ui-shared/src/user-profile/utils.ts:64-86), so the placeholders render verbatim.

findings.claim: The method name 'santizeAnchors' is misspelled; it should be 'sanitizeAnchors'.

verifier.reason: The private method introduced by this patch is misspelled as 'santizeAnchors' at its declaration in misc/theme-verifier/src/main/java/org/keycloak/themeverifier/VerifyMessageProperties.java:150 and at its call site in misc/theme-verifier/src/main/java/org/keycloak/themeverifier/VerifyMessageProperties.java:88.

findings.claim: POLICY_SOME_HTML, POLICY_NO_HTML and HTML_TAGS use constant naming but are non-static instance fields rebuilt per instance. This is inconsistent with the private static final ANCHOR_PATTERN.

verifier.reason: In misc/theme-verifier/src/main/java/org/keycloak/themeverifier/VerifyMessageProperties.java, POLICY_SOME_HTML (line 58), POLICY_NO_HTML (line 63), and HTML_TAGS (line 139) use constant naming but are declared as package-private non-static, non-final instance fields rebuilt for every instance. By contrast, ANCHOR_PATTERN (line 145) in the same class is declared private static final.

findings.claim: The commons-text dependency version 1.13.0 is outdated compared with 1.15.0.

verifier.reason: misc/theme-verifier/pom.xml:80-85 adds org.apache.commons:commons-text at version 1.13.0 (misc/theme-verifier/pom.xml:83), and no other commons-text version is declared in the repository. Whether 1.15.0 exists and makes 1.13.0 outdated cannot be settled from the source code alone and requires consulting an external service such as Maven Central.

findings.claim: The theme verifier anchor check does not fail when a translation drops an anchor present in the source, so translations can lose links and still pass.

verifier.reason: In misc/theme-verifier/src/main/java/org/keycloak/themeverifier/VerifyMessageProperties.java:150-162, `santizeAnchors` only iterates over `matcher.find()` on the translated `value` and never checks after the loop whether `englishMatcher.find()` still has unmatched anchor tags from `englishValue`. As a result, a translation that drops one or all anchor tags present in the English source records no error in `messages` and passes `verifySafeHtml()`.

findings.claim: The sanitize/unescape/strip-comment/trim-diff pipeline and the commons-text dependency duplicate functionality available through OWASP's HtmlChangeListener.

verifier.reason:
OWASP's HtmlChangeListener only reports policy-discarded tags and attributes, silently ignoring HTML comments, unmatched closing tags, unclosed tags, and malformed markup (as OWASP explicitly warns against using it to validate raw input). Because misc/theme-verifier/src/main/java/org/keycloak/themeverifier/VerifyMessageProperties.java:92-112 (with commons-text at misc/theme-verifier/pom.xml:80-85) validates raw properties without replacing them with sanitized output, the string-comparison pipeline catches broken/unsafe HTML—such as the unclosed

, stray , , and fixes in this patch—that HtmlChangeListener cannot detect.
